title: The Best Home Energy Monitors
subtitle: Panel-mounted monitors that show what your home and each circuit use, ranked.
intro: We pulled the whole-home energy monitors on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: circuit-level sensors, local control, and Home Assistant support.
systems_note: Refoss monitors have a native Home Assistant integration with local control. Emporia works through its own app; Home Assistant support for it is community-made.

buyers_guide.a: Whole-home monitors clip current sensors around wires inside your electrical panel. Many people install them, but it means working inside a live panel. Hire an electrician if you're not comfortable.
Two main sensors show your total use. Adding circuit sensors shows which appliances use what, like the dryer, AC, or EV charger.
Many monitors can track solar production and net metering with extra sensors. Check the listing if you have panels.
